relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Following treatment resumption, headache frequency decreased initially to approximately 3–4 mild attacks per month and subsequently to 1–2 attacks per month during the following months

key_findings: Single case: 'on-off-on' pattern of headache frequency with galcanezumab discontinuation and reintroduction in a patient with bipolar disorder and OCD; causality cannot be established.
Patient had CSI 100/100, BDI-II 59 and reduced cognitive screening scores.
